name: Tortoise-TTS
description: Expressive multi-voice TTS with strong voice-cloning quality (neonbjb/tortoise-tts, ~15k stars, active). The base repo is CLI-first (do_tts.py, read.py) but ships a socket streaming server (socket_server.py) and is overwhelmingly self-hosted through community web UIs — most prominently mrq/ai-voice-cloning, a Gradio training+inference webui (default :7860) that adds dataset prep, fine-tuning, and cloning from reference clips. Cloning is driven by dropping reference wavs into a voices/ directory; the exposed webui exposes upload, model selection, and generation with no auth.
auth_notes: No authentication in the tortoise socket_server.py or in the dominant mrq/ai-voice-cloning Gradio webui by default — Gradio launch() runs without auth=, leaving generation, reference-audio upload, voice/model selection, and (in ai-voice-cloning) fine-tuning/training controls open on port 7860. socket_server.py performs no handshake auth on its TCP stream. Operators are expected to bind localhost or reverse-proxy; one-click packages and the ai-voice-cloning bundle frequently expose 0.0.0.0:7860. Gradio share=True (gradio.live) tunnels are a common accidental public-exposure path.

shodan_dorks.rationale: Gradio's inline window.gradio_config JSON blob is the http.html-visible signal for the ai-voice-cloning webui; broad Gradio-on-7860 net to narrow by tortoise labels.
tortoise / ai-voice-cloning app title and voice-preset labels rendered into gradio_config on the index page; direct name match for the dominant webui.
'candidates' (number of tortoise generation candidates) plus the Voice selector are tortoise-specific inference controls surfaced in gradio_config; separates it from generic Gradio TTS demos.
mrq/ai-voice-cloning brands its Gradio tab and headers; near-unique to the dominant tortoise self-host stack.
'autoregressive samples' / diffusion-iteration sliders indicate the full tortoise inference build; use to segment complete deployments for targeted enumeration.

known_vulns: No built-in auth — unauthenticated access to TTS generation, reference-audio upload, voice/model selection, and (ai-voice-cloning) dataset prep + fine-tuning on port 7860
socket_server.py exposes an unauthenticated TCP streaming interface with no origin control
Gradio file-component path-traversal / arbitrary-file-read CVEs (CVE-2024-1561 and related) apply to exposed webui instances on vulnerable Gradio versions
Voice cloning from a handful of reference clips — open webui = turnkey impersonation of any modeled speaker
ai-voice-cloning training tab allows unauthenticated dataset upload and model fine-tuning — attacker-controlled training jobs consume GPU and can poison/replace models
Unrestricted audio upload with no size/MIME validation — GPU/VRAM and disk DoS
share=True gradio.live tunnels publish the UI publicly with no auth
risk_notes: Primary attack vectors: (1) Non-consensual voice cloning — tortoise's high output quality makes an exposed webui a turnkey deepfake generator; a few reference clips of a target yield convincing impersonation for fraud, disinformation, and harassment. (2) GPU compute + training theft — the ai-voice-cloning fine-tuning tab lets an unauthenticated visitor launch expensive training jobs on the operator's GPU, both compute theft and a model-poisoning vector. (3) Cloned-voice / dataset exfiltration — the voices/ and training/ directories accumulate reference audio and finetunes; disclosure leaks reusable voice identities and datasets. (4) Gradio-version file read — chaining a Gradio path-traversal CVE yields arbitrary file read of weights and adjacent secrets. (5) share-tunnel exposure bypasses network controls.
deployment_notes: CUDA GPU host. The base neonbjb/tortoise-tts repo is CLI-first (do_tts.py, read.py) plus socket_server.py (a raw TCP stream, not HTTP — invisible to http.* dorks; find via banner/port heuristics only). The DOMINANT internet-exposed surface is the community Gradio webui, above all mrq/ai-voice-cloning (also 152334H/tortoise-tts-fast which ships a Streamlit app). Fingerprint on that Gradio :7860 surface. SHODAN VISIBILITY CAVEAT: Gradio SPA — rendered UI is JS-only and http.html-blind; pivot on the inline window.gradio_config JSON blob (indexed by Shodan/Censys) plus tortoise control labels ('candidates', 'autoregressive samples'). Censys services.http.response.html_title 'Gradio' + body substring on gradio_config + 'tortoise' is the reliable cross-source method. Base repo active; the live exposed population is overwhelmingly the ai-voice-cloning webui fork.
